gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-plein: Neuropolitical lights up like neon tubing, its letters spread apart and every stroke held to a single line width. Plein, a sans-serif, leads each round letter in through a clear channel, so the tubes above keep the spotlight.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-roundo: Neuropolitical stretches its words out letter by letter, with big open counters in every small letter. Roundo, a sans-serif, keeps its lowercase n arch and stem matched and every small counter unclogged.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads friendly, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and strokes of identical weight in both directions. Neuropolitical earns its keep big and brief, glowing like neon.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-synonym: Neuropolitical looks like neon tubing, each letter spaced well apart. Synonym is sans-serif laid down as a plain stripe of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve that keep the eye moving line after line.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-almendra: Glowing tubes, spaced out: Neuropolitical draws every letter with a pencil that never presses harder. Almendra is a dignified serif with a deep midsection, and it looks best given a little extra size.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-bree-serif: Neuropolitical draws its spaced-out neon letters in a single line thickness, with no shading, while Bree Serif brings outsized lowercase proportions. The standout is the gap between tube-straight lines and a literary serif.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-port-lligat: Neon-sign straightness: Neuropolitical builds uppercase letters from lines of constant thickness, spaced apart. Port Lligat Slab, a serif, is the one for reading, its wide porthole counters and open curves giving letters room to breathe.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-quando: Quando reads bookish and traditional, its sparse, wide letter spacing and big, tall middle zone giving every word room. Neuropolitical's single-width neon tube lines look best given generous size.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-outfit: Neon tubes, spaced out: Neuropolitical lights each letter with a single, steady line thickness. Outfit, with curves that finish well before they close and no swelling or thinning, sits below like bent cable.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-plus-jakarta-s: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, built from monoline strokes with curve endings kept well apart. Shrink Neuropolitical down and its spaced-out neon letters quickly lose their glow.
